detail.longDescription:
Meet Axel — the AI personal assistant that handles your day, knows how you work, and gets more personal every single time you use it.

It listens. It acts. It remembers.
Tell Axel once how you like things done — it never forgets. Prefer short confirmations? Done. Like reminders a certain way? Noted. Every interaction teaches Axel how YOU work. No setup. No configuration. Just use it and watch it adapt.

One assistant. Every way you communicate.
Voice, text, or camera — Axel works across all three and shares context across all three. Start a thought by voice, continue it by text, point your camera to finish it. Axel holds the full thread no matter how you switch.

See it. Act on it. Instantly.
Point your camera at a business card — Axel saves the contact and schedules a follow up. Point at a document — Axel reads it and acts on it. Point at anything — Axel does something real with it. This isn't a scanner. This is an assistant with eyes.

Follow the thread.
Ask Axel about something. Change your mind. Add to it. Redirect it. Axel holds the full context of your conversation and keeps up with how you actually think — in real time, across every interaction. 

Gets better every single day.
Axel learns your preferences over time. The more you use it the more it feels like YOUR assistant — not everyone else's. That's not a feature. That's the whole point.

Works in the background. Works when your screen is locked. Works seamlessly whether you're driving, walking, working, or just being busy.

Your entire day. Handled.
-   📞 Calls, texts, emails and contacts — instantly
-   📅 Calendar, reminders, notes and dynamic todos — effortlessly
-   🗺️ Navigation — directions, sharing, saved places, real-time awareness
-   🎵 Full media control — play, skip, build playlists, hands-free
-   📷 Camera actions — scan, extract, act on what you see
-   📱 App interaction — clipboard, web-search, links, and apps.
-   🔗 Multi-step actions — chain tasks together naturally in conversation
-   🌍 Multilingual — Axel speaks your language, your dialect, your way

Axel — The assistant that becomes yours.

In-App-Purchases: Axel is a paid product, with free-trial access available for eligible users.
